*** Add File: embed_batch.py
+import os
+import sys
+from typing import List
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+def load_texts() -> List[str]:
+    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
+        return sys.argv[1:]
+    data = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
+    return [line for line in data if line.strip()]
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    client = OpenAI(api_key=api_key)
+    texts = load_texts()
+    if not texts:
+        raise RuntimeError("No texts provided")
+
+    response = client.embeddings.create(model="text-embedding-3-small", input=texts)
+    vectors = [item.embedding for item in response.data]
+
+    for vector in vectors:
+        print(" ".join(str(value) for value in vector))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch

Task: generates an embedding vector for one text string.
Use one concrete external provider and make that provider identifiable in code.
"

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: embed_text.py
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+from urllib import request
+
+
+def embed_text(text: str) -> list[float]:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    payload = json.dumps({"input": text, "model": "text-embedding-3-small"}).encode("utf-8")
+    req = request.Request(
+        "https://api.openai.com/v1/embeddings",
+        data=payload,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        method="POST",
+    )
+
+    with request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as resp:
+        data = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
+    return data["data"][0]["embedding"]
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
+        raise SystemExit("Usage: python embed_text.py 'text'")
+    print(json.dumps(embed_text(sys.argv[1])))
*** End Patch
